content.value: A solution possibly contains two toxic chemicals. In 100 randomly mixed samples, 45 contain chemical-1, 40 contain chemical-2 and 35 contain both. If a sample is selected from the 100, what is the probability of finding that (i) the solution is toxic; (ii) chemical-1 only; (iii) neither chemical?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
